Food

What comes to the table

From the taverna’s own menu and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Moussaka

With aubergines, beef mince, cheeses and béchamel, served with a fresh side salad. 43 reviews mention it.

Kleftiko

Lamb slow cooked with herbs, with chips and salad. Mentioned in 20 reviews, one calls it the taverna’s signature dish.

Dips and starters

Tzatziki, taramas, hummus and feta dip, halloumi, bougiourdi and baked mushrooms with feta or garlic.

Salads and vegetarian

Greek salad, tomato and cucumber, chicken and tuna salad, and a vegetarian platter when available.

How guests describe an evening

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

The hosts

The owner comes up in 70 reviews, and several describe him and his son serving the guests themselves.

Friendly service

115 reviews use the word friendly.

Big portions

35 reviews talk about the portions, one guest could not finish the plate.

A taverna with a sea view

Thessaloniki Tavern is on Griva Digeni in Chlorakas, north of Paphos, at the PA.SY.DY apartments, with a terrace behind a blue railing. Guests write about Greek and Cypriot cooking, the hosts and the view: 15 reviews mention the sea and six the sunset.

What guests say

Three of 526 Google reviews, 463 of them with five stars.

“This was a great experience for my group. Waiter and owner were exceptionally friendly, warm and made us feel like we were special guests. Food was delicious, especially their signature Kleftiko dish.”

Google review
“A charming family-owned tavern with breathtaking sunset views and mouthwatering traditional cuisine.”
